Why it matters. Warnings that do not fail the build are soon ignored by the hundred. Treating them as errors in at least one configuration keeps the count at zero.

  • deny warnings: RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" in CI, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, or [lints.rust] warnings = "deny"
